CodeBehindForm
Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False
Attribute VB_Creatable = True
Attribute VB_PredeclaredId = True
Attribute VB_Exposed = False
Option Compare Database

Private Sub Dialog_AfterUpdate()
Dim fs As Form, wform As Form, red As Form, rnconf As DAO.Recordset, stan As Double
Set red = Forms("Редактирование").Form
Set wform = red!wform.Form
If Dialog = 3 Then
'Архив
flist = "select name from список_полей where table=""w"" or table=""d"" or table=""f"";"
red!fromlist = ""
DoCmd.OpenForm ("Выбор_из_списка_м"), , , , , acDialog, flist & "/Редактирование"
DoCmd.OpenForm ("Справка_для_редактирования"), acFormDS
Set fs = Forms("Справка_для_редактирования")
For i = 0 To fs.Controls.Count - 1
If InStr(red!fromlist & ";", fs.Controls(i).Name & ";") > 0 Then
fs.Controls(i).ColumnHidden = False
Else
fs.Controls(i).ColumnHidden = True
End If
Next i
fs.Controls("year").ColumnHidden = False
fs.filter = "numb1120=" & wform!numb1120
fs.FilterOn = True
End If
If Dialog = 1 Then
'Конфигурация ГТУ и ПГУ
stan = IIf(z(wform!MAIN) = 0, wform!numb1120, wform!MAIN)
If z(wform!MAIN) > 0 Then
sqlnconf = "SELECT Count([станция-конфигурация].conf) AS nconf FROM [станция-конфигурация] INNER JOIN Имена_станций ON [станция-конфигурация].stan = Имена_станций.NUMB GROUP BY main HAVING main=" & stan & ";"
Set rnconf = CurrentDb.OpenRecordset(sqlnconf)
If rnconf.RecordCount > 0 Then
If rnconf!nconf > 1 Then stan = wform!numb1120
End If
End If
DoCmd.OpenForm ("Конфигурация(справка)"), , , "stan=" & stan
End If
If Dialog = 2 Then
'Пром.потребители
DoCmd.OpenForm ("Пром_потребители"), acFormDS, , "codest=" & IIf(z(wform!MAIN) = 0, wform!numb1120, wform!MAIN)
End If
End Sub
